rows.text: calls `007A7010(rcx+0x38)` and, only when that returns non-zero, calls `007A81F0(rcx+0x38, ...)` with `xmm1` = `r9d` converted to float and divided by 127.0 (`00906A44`), `xmm2` = `r8d` converted to float and divided by 60.0 (`008F6D54`) and `r9d` = -1; when `007A7010` returns zero it returns without the second call

notes: rdx is not written before the 007A81F0 call, so whatever the caller passed in rdx reaches it unchanged; the row does not claim it as an argument.
